reconverted_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped every Word <w:sym> character, which is how the Register writes some characters in the Symbol and Wingdings fonts, and kept Symbol-font characters typed as text as raw private-use code points (U+F0xx), which display as empty boxes. cth_convert_sym_v2.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0D7 ·, F0B4 ×, F02D −, F0B7 •, F0A3 ≤, F0B3 ≥, F0B0 °, F0A2 ′, F0B2 ″ and the like) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]".

Reconverted from the same Word file (same download sha256); a diff against the first deposit shows no other change (same 9,035 lines; 28 characters added). The deposit had no private-use code points.
